# Deflect Observatory

> A live, deterministic DDoS-mitigation scope. The real deflect-rs Rust primitives,
> compiled to WebAssembly, defending against seeded, replayable synthetic attack
> traffic. Same seed and knobs reproduce a run bit-for-bit.

## What it is
- An interactive visualization of github.com/copyleftdev/deflect-rs, a library of
  composable, kernel-adjacent DDoS-mitigation primitives in Rust.
- Every verdict shown comes from the actual primitive crate, not a mock. Packets
  stream into concentric defense rings (one per primitive) and are dropped,
  challenged, rate-limited, or passed to the protected core.

## The primitives (each a published crate)
- deflect-signature: drops illegal TCP flag combinations (NULL/XMAS/SYN+FIN).
- deflect-reflect: drops unsolicited amplifier replies (DNS/NTP reflection).
- deflect-syncookie: stateless SYN-cookie challenge under SYN flood.
- deflect-ratelimit: exact-integer token bucket, per-/24 governor, volumetric floods.
- deflect-fingerprint: Misra–Gries learned fingerprints of novel floods.
- deflect-detect, deflect-core, deflect-packet, deflect-telemetry, deflect-bgp.
- deflect-kit: umbrella crate re-exporting all of them behind feature flags.

## Install
- cargo add deflect-kit --features full
- use deflect_kit::prelude::*;

## Links
- Repository: https://github.com/copyleftdev/deflect-rs
- Crates: https://crates.io/crates/deflect-kit
